outcome.interpretation_limit: The change and bounded visibility behavior are verified; this does not establish that the broader partial ECI response is complete or that agents received or used the returned row.

pressure_hypothesis.title: ECI response budgeting can omit a verified standalone campaign observation
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A pre-change selected-page readback verified but omitted the only campaign observation. Focused regression tests and the subsequent selected-page readback establish that the row is retained under secondary session context pressure.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Inspect other ECI evidence families for response shapes where useful selected records lack pressure or improvement links and could be lost to secondary context.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: one reproduced selected-window response; recurrence across other evidence shapes or sessions is not established
not_measured: agent intervention burden after this change
response size and resource cost across unrelated evidence families
long-term recurrence or downstream development impact

improvement_relation.basis: The exact implementation blob is integrity-addressed. Focused regression tests preserve standalone selected evidence under an oversized secondary context, and the post-change ECI query returned the selected authentic campaign observation.
not_measured: agent time or tool calls saved
cross-session recurrence or causal effect on development outcomes

measurement_limits: The source response remains partial and reports response truncation; this relation concerns selected-row visibility only.
Verification and readback do not measure agent receipt, intervention reduction, or sustained effectiveness.
